Query actual resources and inspect realized stores; do not launch a broad occupancy sweep or infer elapsed-time savings from opcode counts.

ideas.title: Can grouped-stage work preserve useful B7 progress without losing queried CTA capacity or equal-capacity down performance?
ideas.mechanism: A larger shared ring reduces queried maximum active up CTA capacity, while actual scheduling, batching/startup and producer ILP remain confounded; down losses at equal queried capacity show this capacity alone is insufficient. ideas.discriminator: Preserve both signed B7 outcomes and compare only a resource-accounted grouping refinement or existing producer/consumer diagnostic. Keep the same frozen workload per F1 bracket; do not hardcode a B7 winner or repeat a broad group sweep.

ideas.title: Does a proposed F1 comparison preserve exact activation and routing work across all arms/endpoints?
